title: End of Season Update
preview: Wrapping up our first FTC season with two league wins, a playoff alliance captain spot, and a lot of plans for next year.
body:
Thank you to everyone who followed our first FTC season. We won both Maxwell League meets, captained a playoff alliance at the Hawking Interleague, and placed 2nd in our region for the Think Award.

Off the field, we planted over 3,000 trees through Sea Forest, ran 21 outreach events, and launched TeamForge — a free team-management platform for FTC and FLL teams.

We are already planning for next season. If you want to support us as a sponsor, join the team, or just stay in touch, use the contact form below.
